cards.title: Why it works
items: Carrier scale without the folklore: every rule that keeps carriers honest is a node or a gate here — premise-first intake, commit-before-verify, tiered blind review through a join, after_partial on the judges
A complementary premise-gate pair routes dead questions to a stand-down terminal, so a blocked premise ends in a labeled record, never a silent drop
The exit is a no-token machine gate: the run cannot go greener than the checkout snapshot it found, and a machine timeout is failure, not approval

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes, {{gates}} gates, {{branches}} branches, {{edges}} edges: intake -> premise pair -> build -> test -> fix -> judges -> review join -> PR | stand-down -> machine exit-check
Review tiers itself on the diff-size line: sub-threshold diffs are single-reviewed and the join reads the skip as policy, not as loss
